title: Inclusive onboarding & insurance partners
subtitle: Secure, review-based onboarding for participants, community support organisations and insurance institutions. A submitted record is not an approval.
evidenceFile: Evidence document (PDF, JPEG or PNG; max 10 MiB)
notOperational: Blocked — no verified live financial adapter
noEvidence: Select a valid PDF, JPEG or PNG evidence file.
success: Submission recorded. Await the authorised server-side review.
failed: The request could not be completed.
privacy: Collect only information required for this workflow. Do not upload unrelated medical, family or displacement-history documents.
translationNotice: Swahili, French and Arabic interface resources are drafts pending qualified linguistic and legal review. English is the source language.
participantRef: Participant account reference (authorised assisted registration only)
assistedNote: Assisted registration is enforced by backend permissions and still requires an independent reviewer.
amountMinor: Expected amount in currency minor units
noLivePayments: No live payment initiation or payout settlement is enabled here. Use the approved canonical financial pathway only.
errorLoad: Some operational data could not be loaded. Verify your tenant scope and permission, then retry.
productTermsNotice: Product references only. Terms and eligibility are owned by the insurer and remain subject to review.
licenceReviewNotice: The licence document is stored encrypted. Submission remains pending until a separate authorised compliance review.
insuranceConsentExplain: Read the insurer-specific notice before choosing. Consent is optional and may be withdrawn; the service may not proceed without a valid lawful basis and required consent.
recipientTenantRequired: Enter the insurer tenant ID first.
checkRecipientFirst: Verify the insurer and display its notice before granting consent.
consentRequired: Explicit consent is required for this data-sharing purpose.
consentAffirmation: I have read the notice above and explicitly agree to the stated, insurer-specific data sharing for insurance enrolment.
reviewerSecurityNote: Server-side reviewer permission, tenant scope, assignment and separation-of-duties checks still apply. Enter the participant user ID in the current tenant, not a document ID.
participantFacingReviewNote: Participant-facing note (required when requesting more information)
partnerReviewerNote: Requires the partner-review permission. The submitter cannot review their own organisation; the server records the evidence source and decision history.
reviewReason: Reason (required for more information, rejection or suspension)
licenceReviewerNote: Requires licence-review permission, source evidence and separation of duties. An administrator who submitted the licence cannot approve it.
retirementSubtitle: Track retirement-support cases, document evidence, contribution discrepancies and optional referrals. TITech does not determine official benefit eligibility or hold pension funds.
retirementCapabilityDisabled: Retirement-support submissions are disabled for this environment
retirementAuthorityBoundary: Government pension and NSSF systems remain authoritative. Submitted documents and matching remittances are not official verification or proof of member-account credit.
retirementNewCaseHelp: Select the correct scheme and case type. Upload only documents required by the approved workflow.
retirementSchemeReferenceHelp: The raw reference is not stored. Fingerprint-based duplicate matching requires a dedicated key to be configured by the operator.
retirementEvidenceHelp: PDF, JPEG or PNG; maximum 10 MiB. Uploads are privately stored and tenant-scoped.
retirementFinancialSupportHelp: This submits a support request only. No credit, insurance, savings product or payment is approved by TITech through this form.
retirementNoApprovalPromise: Provider approval, pricing, eligibility and disbursement are determined by an authorized provider under applicable rules.
retirementNoCases: No retirement-support cases found for this account.
retirementContributionEvidence: Contribution records visible to this account
retirementContributionBoundary: A matching amount comparison does not prove that the pension scheme or NSSF credited the member account.
retirementNoMoneyMovement: No funds are moved by this workflow. A provider decision or request reference is not a settlement.
retirementLoadFailed: Could not load retirement-support data. Check the API, tenant and permissions.
retirementOperationFailed: The requested operation could not be completed.
retirementEvidenceRequired: Select a supporting document before submitting the case.
retirementEvidenceInvalid: Use a non-empty PDF, JPEG or PNG smaller than 10 MiB.
retirementEvidenceUploadFailed: The private document service did not return a document reference.
retirementPrivacyNoticeBody: TITech Capital LTD uses the information and private documents you submit to manage this retirement-support case, check completeness, record review activity and respond to your request. The responsible pension scheme or provider remains authoritative for membership, eligibility, benefit decisions and credited contributions. Information is shared externally only through a separately authorised process and applicable lawful basis. This notice acknowledgement is not consent to marketing or an automatic authorisation to share records.
retirementPrivacyNoticeAcknowledge: I have read and understood this retirement-support privacy notice.
retirementPrivacyPolicyNotConfigured: Submissions are unavailable until the current notice version and processing basis are approved and configured by the deployment owner.
retirementPrivacyAcknowledgementRequired: Read and acknowledge the current privacy notice before submitting.
retirementNoticeAcknowledgementScope: This acknowledgement records that the notice was shown and read; it is not a blanket consent to unrelated data sharing.
retirementStaffCaseQueueHelp: Review cases within your authorized tenant scope. Official confirmation must be recorded only from the approved institutional source or an authorized manual review.
retirementNoQueueCases: No cases are currently in the institutional queue.
retirementContributionSetupHelp: Enter policy-approved expected amounts. This does not represent a remittance, settlement or official scheme credit.
retirementContributionCaseRequired: Select a case before recording contribution expectations.
retirementNoQueueSupport: No financial-support applications are currently in the queue.
retirementStatusSchemeVerified: Scheme verified by recorded authority evidence
